title: YouWorkforce normalized event v1
description: Contract line 46. Tenant/site/device resolved server-side; body is never authoritative for tenant.

idem_key.description: stable dedup key per tenant/source; defaults to source_event

notes: Idempotency is enforced by UNIQUE(tenant_id, source, idem_key).
A stale GPS must be presented as last-known position with timestamp, not current.
Critical etypes (sos, man_down, immobilita, mancato_checkin) open an incident + outbox notify in one transaction.
